name: rosetta-idiomatically-determine-all-the-lowercase-and-uppercase-letters
code:
use default

letters(matches: (char) -> bool) -> string =>
    string(
        (0..65536)
        |> map(code => cast char(code))
        |> filter(matches)
        |> collect_array()
    )

write_line("lowercase {letters(char.is_ascii_letter_lower)}")
write_line("uppercase {letters(char.is_ascii_letter_upper)}")
